text.p: Plum Creek Timber Co LP said Wednesday it filed a registration statement covering the sale of up to 5,000,000 depositary units representing limited partnership interests in Plum Creek Timber Co LP.
In a statement, Plum Creek said it plans up to an additional 750,000 depositary units pursuant to an underwriters' over-allotment option.

Plum Creek said it intends to use the proceeds of the offering to repay a portion of the bank financing that will be used for the $540 million purchase price of its previously announced acquisition from Riverwood International Corp RVW.N of 538,000 acres of timberland located in northern Louisiana and southern Arkansas. The acquisition also includes two sawmills, a plywood plant, and a nursery in Texas. The proposed offering is contingent upon the closing of the acquisition.
